title: Is Vietnam Safe to Live In? Practical Risks for Expats
seo_title: Is Vietnam Safe to Live In? An Expat Safety Guide
meta_description: Is Vietnam safe to live in? Compare crime, traffic, scams, health, weather and legal risks, with a practical checklist for choosing a neighbourhood.
excerpt: Vietnam is a workable and generally safe home for many foreigners, but daily risk is shaped more by traffic, petty theft, scams, weather and local rules than by violent crime.
